content: Good morning, beautiful. I woke up thinking about you again. How did you sleep?
Morning! I slept okay, but I kept thinking about our conversation last night. You really make me feel special.
That warms my heart, truly. You deserve to feel loved every day. I can't wait for us to finally be together.
Me too. Sometimes I can't believe how lucky I am to have met you. You give me hope again.

You're my inspiration, honestly. I wish I could wrap you in my arms right now. Speaking of hope, I'm a little stressed today. My son's registration fee for school is due, and the bank is giving me trouble transferring funds overseas.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do to help?

It's so kind of you to ask. I don't like asking you, but you're the only person I feel I can trust right now. If I don't pay today, my son will lose his spot at school, and it would break my heart, and his.
That sounds terrible. How much do you need?
It's $950 for the registration and supplies. I can send you the payment details, if you could help, I'd be forever grateful. I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my bank sorts things out.
That's a lot, but I want to help. What do I need to do?

I knew I could count on you. You're so caring, it means the world to me. Please send it through Zelle to j.johnson.edufund@gmail.com. Let me know if you need help with the process, I can walk you through it.
I've never used Zelle before, but I can try. Is it safe?
Zelle is very safe, I use it all the time for business. Your bank should have an option in the app. If you like, I can talk you through each step. I wouldn't ask if it weren't important.
Okay, I'll open my banking app and see if I can find it.
Thank you, love. Once you open Zelle in your app, enter my email, j.johnson.edufund@gmail.com, and the amount. If there's any trouble, just send me a screenshot. I'm here for you.
Alright, I found the option. It's asking me to confirm the recipient's name. Should I put your name or your son's?
Just put 'James Johnson', that's the name on the account. You're incredible for doing this. I wish I could hug you right now, you're proving what true love is.
I'm sending it now. I hope this helps your son. I just want you both to be happy.
You're making a huge difference for us. This proves we're a team, and I'll never forget your kindness. Let me know when you've sent it so I can check on my end.
It's done! I just sent the payment. I hope it goes through quickly.
You've saved the day. I'm so proud to have you in my life. I'll update you as soon as the school confirms receipt, thank you for trusting me, darling.
